info.name: Query Inventory
info.description:
# Description Query Inventory is a simple query tool, to retrieve information about inventory using location code(s) and itemNumber(s). ## Getting Started 1. Populate the collection variables with your Consumer Key (`clientId`) and Consumer Secret (`clientSecret`) 2. In the collection's Authorization section, use the *Get New Access Token* button to get an access token, then click *Use Token* so it can be used in subsequent requests. ## Environments We have three environments to help you develop your applications and safely interface with our APIs. You can use the three environments as part of your SDLC in progressing your application from sandbox, to test to our live APIs. Check the collection variables to set the correct `baseUrl` and `authenticationURL` to match the environment for your API keys. | **Environment** | **URLs** | | --- | --- | | **Sandbox** | AuthN URL: [https://connect.sandbox.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token](https://connect.sandbox.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token)

Base URL: [https://inventory.sandbox.api.bunnings.com.au/inventory](https://inventory.sandbox.api.bunnings.com.au/inventory) | | **Test** | AuthN URL: [https://authorisation-stg.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token](https://authorisation-stg.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token)

Base URL: [https://inventory.stg.api.bunnings.com.au/inventory](https://inventory.stg.api.bunnings.com.au/inventory) | | **Live** | AuthN URL: [https://authorisation.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token](https://authorisation.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token)

Base URL: [https://inventory.api.bunnings.com.au/inventory](https://inventory.api.bunnings.com.au/inventory) | ## Security Depending on the scope held, more or less functionality is available at an endpoint. There are further access controls in place to ensure the scope of the inventory lookup functionality is within a bounds suitable for the client making the request. ### inv:pub Get basic inventory information back pertaining to the inventory ## HATEOAS The Inventory API is built following the HATEOAS guidelines. When using the API, the client should start by first calling the `discovery` operation to get a list of possible links these links can then be followed to perform functions. If no correlation token is provided when using this service, it will generate a token for you in the header response. Contact Support: Name: Developer Support Email: [developer@bunnings.com.au](mailto:developer@bunnings.com.au)

query.description:
Select can optionally be used to project only the required properties of the entity/entities from the server.
- list required properties separated with a ','.
- property names are case insensitive.
- '\\*' can be used as a wild card for any property.
- use '/' to address complex type properties.

example: $select=name,address/state,contact/*/phoneNumber
